newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE - BOURSE POWERS ON TO MORE RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE - BOURSE POWERS ON TO MORE RECORDS.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data show bourse turnover at new high
of 193.4 million kroons compared to 93.4 million kroons.
* Index gains 2.39 percent to set new record at 398.64.
* Hoiupank gains 13.50 kroons to close at new
record of 250 kroons, turnover 47.2 million kroons after
* Hansapank , most active, turns over 56.7 million
kroons to gain 2.5 kroons to 225 kroons, also another new high.
